Errors.notANumber: Formula does not resolve to a number (got "{resolved}")

conditional.missingElse: $conditional(...) is missing a required else(...) clause
conditional.multipleElse: $conditional(...) has more than one else(...) clause
conditional.whenArgCount: when(...) requires exactly two arguments: when(condition, value)
conditional.elseArgCount: else(...) requires exactly one argument: else(value)

function.missingProjection: $find(...) must be followed by a .property projection (e.g. $find(...).range)
